linhas.txt: Hello, exploradora! Whose book is this? It's MY book! Whose dog? HER dog! Os possessive adjectives mostram QUEM É O DONO de uma coisa — e olha que legal: eles vêm BEM ANTES da coisa! Let's go!
POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES show who something belongs to. They go BEFORE the noun.
it ITS (the dog and its ball)
Tip: the possessive comes BEFORE the noun 'my book', NOT 'book my'.
Careful: ITS = belongs to it (its tail). Don't mix with IT'S = it is.
